0.6.0: Added staged daily recording: timestamped Markdown quick notes and attachments before the evening diary form opens, with a default reflection window of 7 pm to midnight in the configured timezone.
Added shared administrator-controlled opening times with Apply now and Save for tomorrow options.

Added complete, incomplete, and missing days to patient and assigned-therapist archives from the patient’s join date, including read-only access to saved notes, attachments, and unfinished drafts after midnight.
Kept earlier notes and attachments hidden during reflection until the full card is submitted, while preserving existing post-submission addenda and uploads.
Preserved early files through full submission, enforced attachment quotas across recording stages, and added integrity checks and recovery support for incomplete records.
Reduced admin dashboard memory and file-reading work with on-demand integrity verification, streamed checksums, and leaner notification queries.
Fixed browser submission errors caused by action buttons masking the form URL, for both text-only saves and attachment uploads.
0.5.1: Added upload progress bars with percentages and transferred size for diary submission and attachments added to existing cards.
Added a saving indicator after transfer completes and disabled repeat submissions while uploads are in progress.
Added upload error feedback that preserves entered text and selected files, including messages for oversized requests and connection failures.
0.5.0: Added an attachment viewer for images, MP4 video, and MP3/M4A audio, with previous/next navigation and downloads for patients and therapists.
Added administrator-configurable attachment limits, defaulting to 100 MiB per file and 500 MiB per card, with upload queue usage indicators and server-side validation.
Added authenticated media streaming with byte-range requests for seeking, plus chunked attachment storage and checksum verification.
Added a configurable upload worker timeout and documented reverse-proxy requirements for larger uploads and media playback.
Refresh archive pages restored with browser Back navigation.
0.4.2: Added a patient notification bell with an unread counter and a menu linking each unread therapist comment directly to its diary card.
Added unread comment badges to the patient archive and calendar. Opening a card marks its comments as read, and returning with the browser Back button refreshes the counts.
Improved mobile navigation with Signals, Archive, Today/New, and Notifications in that order, plus a responsive notification menu and matching button highlights.
Added weekday names to patient and therapist archive dates, card details, Today, notification dates, and Signals summaries (TICKET-0013).
Added attachment and comment totals to archive lists, ordered as comments, addendums, and attachments. Counts stack on desktop and use a compact line on mobile, with a full-height date divider.
0.4.1: Added content-blind file-count and Journalmax storage summaries to the administrator overview.
Added capacity bars that distinguish Journalmax card files from overall drive usage and remaining free space.
Reorganized overview status cards into a clearer responsive operational summary.
0.4.0: Updates verify a bundled signed release manifest without storing GitHub or GHCR credentials on the service host.
The Updates workspace now includes a release changelog and a temporary maintenance-tools section.
Administrators can check for and permanently purge credentials left by the previous updater model.
0.3.3: Added a calmer step-by-step diary form and cumulative emotion intensity meters.
Added post-submission attachments with inline previews and improved file selection.
Added inactivity logout, temporary action notices, and feedback submission without page refreshes.
